summary: Season 04-01..10-31 -> 04-01..11-30 (RA: closed Dec 1-Mar 31); count 19 confirmed (18 electric + 1 full-hookup pull-through), max 66 ft, pull-through; hookups 50 + water + sewer (one full-hookup site); facilities showers/flush/vault/water/dump; booking 100% reservable Apr 1-Nov 30. Not waterfront kept (RA Near Water - no on all; road + trees between). Note cleaned ('9 also have water' unsupported).
flags: WATERFRONT (not waterfront kept): the Des Moines River (~80-90 m wide, river-class) runs along the east side of the park, but every RA site is tagged 'Near Water - no' and the GIS-plotted sites sit ~75-130 m from the bank under closed canopy, with the park's through road, a day-use lawn and trees between. The DNR's 'overlooks the Des Moines River' is general park prose, and no site photo shows the river. Prairie Creek is not near the loop.
HOOKUPS: water and sewer rest on ONE public site (H23, 66-ft full-hookup pull-through). The old note's '9 also have water' has no support on RA or the DNR page and was dropped.
